mapper.insert: insert into sku (product_id, merchant_id, name, price, stock, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

(#{s.productId}, #{s.merchantId}, #{s.name}, #{s.price}, #{s.stock}, #{s.status}, #{s.createTime}, #{s.updateTime})
mapper.delete: delete from sku where product_id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId}
delete from sku where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and id in #{id}
mapper.select: select * from sku where product_id = #{productId} order by id
mapper.update: update sku set stock = stock - #{number}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and stock >= #{number}
